'''DC-GNK''' was a originally a [[GNK power droid/Legends|GNK]]-series [[Power droid/Legends|power droid]], later heavily modified to serve as a translator by [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Empideera Kkek]]. DC-GNK was outfitted with a number of salvaged [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] parts, allowing him to help Kkek in trade negotiations. Although DC-GNK was grateful for his transformation into a more intelligent [[Droid/Legends|droid]], he longed to have his own life, away from the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]].<ref name="Secrets" />

==Behind the scenes==
DC-GNK was first mentioned in the ''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]'' roleplaying game supplement.<ref name="Secrets" /> The droid was not pictured until an entry in ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'', which actually used images of a different GNK droid from the [[Droids (1995) 2|''Droids'' (1995) 2]] comic book to visually represent DC-GNK.<ref name="FF122" />
